leaders.name: Matt Loszak
leaders.title: CEO & Cofounder
leaders.background: Nuclear engineering and physics degree. Founded Humi (HR software) and had a nine-figure exit. Y Combinator alum.
leaders.why_they_matter: Non-traditional-nuclear founder background (software exit) signals a startup-speed, product-company approach rather than an incumbent-nuclear pedigree.

leaders.name: Yasir Arafat
leaders.title: CTO, President, & Cofounder
leaders.background: Former lead of Idaho National Laboratory's MARVEL microreactor program. Founded the Westinghouse eVinci program. Ten years of R&D on the AP1000 reactor.
leaders.why_they_matter: Brings direct DOE/national-lab microreactor program leadership (MARVEL) and incumbent-vendor (Westinghouse) reactor design experience into a startup.
